_about: Artifact Hunt's hud (docs/notes/artefact_hunt.md, HUD calls): the four dictionary texts the hud movie shows that are no st_srp_* key (those the localization compile maps itself), each mapped to itself in hud_strings: the take and put prompts and the pregame countdown are the game's own texts, "Round restarts in" is scripts/artefact-hunt/texts.tsv's. Text lives in client-patches/localization/*.tsv.
